Plain-language definition: Blood pressure that stays higher than normal over time.
Example from a note: Pt has a hx of HTN, well controlled on lisinopril.

Plain-language definition: Very high blood pressure without signs of new organ damage.
Example from a note: BP 192/118 on arrival; no chest pain or neuro deficits. Hypertensive urgency.

Plain-language definition: Very high blood pressure with signs of new organ damage, such as to the heart, brain or kidneys.
Example from a note: Hypertensive emergency with acute kidney injury; admitted to ICU.

Plain-language definition: Thickening of the wall of the heart's main pumping chamber, often from years of high blood pressure.
Example from a note: Echo shows mild LVH, likely 2/2 longstanding HTN.

Plain-language definition: Long-term loss of kidney function. High blood pressure is a leading cause.
Example from a note: CKD stage 3, followed by nephrology.

Plain-language definition: Brain injury from blocked or bleeding blood flow. High blood pressure raises the risk.
Example from a note: PMH: HTN, prior CVA without residual deficits.

Plain-language definition: A class of medicines that relax blood vessels by blocking a hormone that narrows them.
Example from a note: Started on an ACE inhibitor for BP control.

Plain-language definition: An ACE inhibitor commonly used to treat high blood pressure.
Example from a note: Continue lisinopril 10 mg PO daily.

Plain-language definition: A class of medicines that relax blood vessels; often used if an ACE inhibitor causes a cough.
Example from a note: Switched from ACE inhibitor to ARB due to cough.

Plain-language definition: An ARB used to treat high blood pressure.
Example from a note: Losartan 50 mg PO daily.

Plain-language definition: A 'water pill' that helps the kidneys remove extra salt and water, lowering blood pressure.
Example from a note: Add a thiazide diuretic if BP remains above goal.

Plain-language definition: A thiazide diuretic used to treat high blood pressure.
Example from a note: HCTZ 25 mg PO daily.

Plain-language definition: A class of medicines that relax blood vessel walls to lower blood pressure.
Example from a note: Pt on a CCB for HTN.

Plain-language definition: A calcium channel blocker used to treat high blood pressure.
Example from a note: Amlodipine 5 mg PO daily.

Plain-language definition: Pain in the head. Can occur with very high blood pressure, though most people with HTN have no symptoms.
Example from a note: Pt reports headache; BP elevated at 178/104.

Plain-language definition: A persistent cough without mucus; a known side effect of ACE inhibitors.
Example from a note: Reports dry cough since starting lisinopril.

Plain-language definition: Swelling from extra fluid in the body's tissues, often in the ankles; a possible side effect of amlodipine.
Example from a note: 1+ bilateral LE edema.

Plain-language definition: The force of blood against artery walls, written as systolic over diastolic (e.g., 120/80).
The top number in a BP reading: pressure when the heart beats.
Example from a note: SBP consistently > 140 on home readings.

Plain-language definition: The bottom number in a BP reading: pressure when the heart rests between beats.
Example from a note: DBP 95 today.

Plain-language definition: A blood test that checks kidney function and electrolytes; often ordered when starting or adjusting BP meds.
Example from a note: Repeat BMP in 2 weeks after starting lisinopril.

Plain-language definition: A waste product in the blood; higher levels can mean the kidneys aren't working as well.
Example from a note: Cr 1.4, up from baseline 1.1.

Plain-language definition: An electrolyte important for heart rhythm; some BP meds raise it and others lower it.
Example from a note: K 5.3 on ACE inhibitor; will monitor.

Plain-language definition: A test that records the heart's electrical activity; can show signs of LVH.
Example from a note: EKG: NSR, voltage criteria for LVH.

Plain-language definition: An ultrasound of the heart that shows its structure and pumping.
Example from a note: Echo ordered to evaluate for LVH.

Plain-language definition: History (e.g., a past condition).
Example from a note: hx of HTN x 10 years.

Plain-language definition: Patient.
Example from a note: Pt is a 58 y/o M with HTN.

Plain-language definition: Past medical history: the patient's previous and ongoing conditions.
Example from a note: PMH: HTN, HLD, T2DM.

Plain-language definition: By mouth (from Latin 'per os').
Example from a note: Lisinopril 10 mg PO daily.

Plain-language definition: Secondary to; caused by.
Example from a note: LVH 2/2 longstanding HTN.
